title: Chapter 43: Life And Death Contest
content:
Chapter 43: Life And Death Contest

Wang Shuo gave him a few more orders to test his execution ability.

The result made Wang Shuo very satisfied, and there was not much difference from normal people.

And Wang Shuo was particularly satisfied with the fact that he obeyed unconditionally.

Even if he was asked to hit his head with a stone, he did not hesitate at all.

Wang Shuo instantly liked this subordinate and had to buy him a good outfit.

He immediately searched in his backpack and kept some of the equipment he had made before as a backup.

After putting on the equipment.

Wang Shuo checked Gong Zheng's attribute panel again.

Found that there were more "qualification" attributes and a "blocking" skill.

This made Wang Shuo a little overjoyed. It seemed that he could be trained into a tank, and the blocking skill was just right for resisting damage.

With the addition of new members, Wang Shuo ordered a table of wine and food and celebrated.

After eating and drinking, Wang Shuo decided to return to his territory to have a look. After leaving for a few days, it would be a pity if his chickens and goats starved to death!

Through the base camp, Wang Shuo took Gong Zheng and Da Huang back to his territory.

When he arrived at the farm, he saw that the poultry he raised was starving to death!

Wang Shuo quickly fed them food, but unfortunately, half of them died.

It seems that he must find someone to take care of the farm and farm at home.

He took Gong Zheng to inspect his territory, and then assigned him a room and bedding. Finally, Wang Shuo lay on his warm big bed and fell asleep.

The next morning, after Wang Shuo woke up, he was squatting and the voice of Master Zach sounded.

[Dear lucky players, are you a little confused about why there is no movement in the elimination round? ]

[I will officially tell you now that the past few days are for you to prepare, just treat it as a holiday for you. Now the elimination round has entered the most exciting part. ]

[Please pay attention to your task bar. ]

Wang Shuo immediately opened the [Task] bar.

(Day 17, 8:00 AM, current area survivors: 1091/10000.)

[Main quest]: Survive to the end.

[Side quest]

1. Collect more supplies, build more buildings, make more tools, upgrade higher-level shelters, ... to get a higher ranking.

2. Life and death competition: The territories of players in this area will border each other, and only one player can survive in the end. This is destined to be a life-and-death battle!

There are no tasks to upgrade the territory for the time being, and it seems that it will not be able to be upgraded in a short time.

The newly generated tasks made Wang Shuo suddenly nervous and a little sad.

After all, this is a battle with his compatriots. In the survival world, everything is out of one's control.

Just then, Wang Shuo noticed that a cloud of fog appeared on the southern edge of his territory.

It was just like the fog when he first appeared in this world.

Wang Shuo acted quickly. It was related to his life and death, and he could not be careless.

Wang Shuo prepared weapons and supplies, and walked slowly towards the fog with Gong Zheng, Da Huang and the golden-armored warrior.

When he came to the edge of the fog, Wang Shuo observed the fog in front of him while paying attention to the changes in the map.

After waiting for a while, there was no movement. It seemed that the opposing players did not intend to rush over.

Either they hid timidly, or they were ambushed in full battle array.

Because this mandatory conflict came very suddenly, everyone should not be mentally prepared. As for the preparation of supplies, they should have prepared some.

Wang Shuo frowned deeply, and hesitated for a while, whether to rush into the fog.

"Agui, do you have any suggestions?"

When in doubt, quantum mechanics!

Wang Shuo planned to listen to Chang Gui's ideas.

"I think our current strength should be the best among the players, and we can try to enter the opponent's territory."

Wang Shuo did not want to fight with the opponent, but the task issued by Lord Zach was definitely not a joke.

If the two of them kept hiding, the final result would definitely not be good.

On the contrary, if you quickly solve the opponent, you may get extra rewards.

After making up his mind, Wang Shuo decided to take the initiative to attack, but he only had one life, so he must not rush to the front. If the opponent set up a trap in advance, he would be reckless if he rushed into it.

Wang Shuo smiled and looked at Gong Zheng, the golden armored warrior and Da Huang.

Gong Zheng was a little dull, his level was too low, and he had spent a lot of money to recruit him, so he couldn't take risks.

The cost of the golden armored warrior was also very high, so Wang Shuo finally chose Da Huang.

It was small in size and very alert, which was very suitable for this kind of reconnaissance and exploration work.

"Da Huang, go!" Wang Shuo whispered to Da Huang, "I'll give you chicken legs tonight."

Da Huang was scared and took a few steps back silently.

"Coward, can you be a little more promising?" Wang Shuo took out a piece of mutton and handed it to Da Huang, and threatened that if you don't go, I will eat dog meat hot pot tonight.

Da Huang was very human and seemed to understand what Wang Shuo said.

He ate the mutton and walked towards the fog reluctantly.

As soon as Da Huang stepped into the fog, the fog began to dissipate.

A passage appeared in front of him, and Wang Shuo ordered the second golden-armored warrior to follow, then Gong Zheng, and finally himself.

Wang Shuo put all his fighting strength into it. After all, it was a matter of life and death, so it was never too careful.

After walking for more than 10 meters, the system prompt appeared:

[You have entered Huang Feiguang's territory. 】

"Huang Feiguang?"

Wang Shuo was surprised. This is really a narrow road for enemies!

Then, the fog around him dissipated.

Wang Shuo didn't know whether it was because he entered the opponent's territory or because the time was up that caused the fog to dissipate.

But it didn't matter.

In front of him was a green grassland.

In the distance, a stone house appeared, but it looked far worse than his own courtyard.

After a careful observation, Wang Shuo did not find Huang Feiguang's figure. It seemed that the kid was hiding.

This made Wang Shuo less nervous.

Next, Wang Shuo searched carefully.

Soon, Da Huang shouted beside a small raised mound of earth.

Wang Shuo walked closer and muttered, "They even built fortifications."

This made Wang Shuo dare not underestimate him!

Huang Feiguang should have a lot of advantages in the early stage, and he should have developed very well, so he might have a killer weapon in his hand.

Wang Shuo planned not to attack the bunker first.

Instead, he carefully explored his territory and analyzed it to see if he could judge his true strength.

In the stone house, the furnishings were very simple, the sheets and quilts on the bed were very messy, and a pillow fell to the ground.

There were some unwashed bowls on the dining table, with some leftovers.

It can be seen that it should be the takeaway from Chef Zhang's house, because there was Wang Shuo's exclusive mark on the bowl.

"You live a comfortable life!"

Wang Shuo thought that he could already make porcelain bowls. After dealing with Huang Feiguang, he could find Chef Zhang to discuss another business, if Chef Zhang was still alive.
